title: The drifting vibration sampler
hints: Write down the tick of each sample with the starter: 0, 12, 24, 36... Every period is 10 ticks *plus* the filtering time. What should the sleep be measured from instead?
Use `rtos_delay_until(&next_wake, SAMPLE_PERIOD)`. It sleeps until an absolute tick and moves `next_wake` forward by exactly one period, however long the work took.

Before the loop: `rtos_tick_t next_wake = rtos_now();`. At the end of each iteration, replace `rtos_delay(SAMPLE_PERIOD)` with `rtos_delay_until(&next_wake, SAMPLE_PERIOD);`. Don't reset `next_wake` inside the loop.
